purpose: Review-only Dataverse model for moving TACATDP and future CRDB Sustainable Finance MEL calculations from dashboard code into governed indicator definitions, observations, evidence, source mappings, and indicator results.
scope: No Dataverse table creation, table-permission change, site-setting change, import, or deployment is authorized by this file.
TACATDP remains the first configured project; the schema must support broader programme and operational MEL scopes without TACATDP-only table names.
design_decisions: Keep canonical form submissions and imported report rows as evidence/source records; indicator facts are derived from them.
Represent each KPI as metadata in mp_IndicatorDefinition instead of hard-coding formulas inside dashboard components.
Normalize measured, estimated, and modelled inputs as mp_Observation records before producing aggregate mp_IndicatorResult rows.
Use mp_DataSourceMapping to document which form field, import column, Dataverse table, or integration value feeds each indicator input.
Link evidence to observations/results so official values can be traced back to submissions, GPS/photo/document references, timestamps, and verification status.
Store method and verification status on observations and results; do not combine estimated and verified values without exposing that status.
Use project-scoped alternate keys for idempotent imports and scheduled recalculation.

tables.name: mp_IndicatorDefinition
tables.purpose: Configures an indicator/KPI, including formula, unit, frequency, source mappings, disaggregation, and verification method.

columns.name: mp_name
columns.notes: Human-readable indicator name.

columns.name: mp_code
columns.notes: Stable project-scoped code such as TAC-BEN-001 or SFU-FIN-001.

columns.name: mp_project
columns.notes: Programme/project boundary. Null may be used only for reusable enterprise indicators.

columns.name: mp_description
columns.notes: Plain-language definition for MEL officers and reviewers.

columns.name: mp_indicatortype
columns.notes: Classifies the indicator for UI grouping and review.

columns.name: mp_resultlevel
columns.notes: Flexible result-framework level.

columns.name: mp_unit
columns.notes: Examples: count, TZS, percent, hectares, tCO2e.

columns.name: mp_formula
columns.notes: Reviewable formula expression or narrative method. Empty for directly reported indicators.

columns.name: mp_numerator
columns.notes: Numerator definition where applicable.

columns.name: mp_denominator
columns.notes: Denominator definition where applicable.

columns.name: mp_reportingfrequency
columns.notes: Expected reporting cadence.

columns.name: mp_disaggregationjson
columns.notes: JSON list of supported breakdown dimensions such as region, district, sex, youth, crop, technology, and borrower type.

columns.name: mp_datasourcemappingjson
columns.notes: Compact source mapping summary for quick review. Detailed rows live in mp_DataSourceMapping.

columns.name: mp_verificationmethod
columns.notes: Evidence and review method required before treating results as official.

columns.name: mp_responsibleunit
columns.notes: Responsible CRDB unit or approved partner.

columns.name: mp_reportingframework
columns.notes: Framework label such as GCF, CRDB internal, SFU portfolio, or programme-specific.

columns.name: mp_status
columns.notes: Only active indicators should feed production dashboards.

tables.name: mp_DataSourceMapping
tables.purpose: Maps a source field/table/path to an indicator input so dashboards and reports do not own hidden formulas.

columns.name: mp_mappingkey
columns.notes: Stable key such as indicatorCode:sourceType:sourcePath.

columns.name: mp_project
columns.notes: Project scope for programme-specific mappings.

columns.name: mp_indicatordefinition
columns.notes: Indicator that consumes this source.

columns.name: mp_sourcetype
columns.notes: Source category.

columns.name: mp_sourcetable
columns.notes: Source table or entity set, for example mp_SubmissionReportRow.

columns.name: mp_sourcecolumn
columns.notes: Source column or imported workbook column.

columns.name: mp_sourcepath
columns.notes: XForm XPath or JSON path inside canonical/report payload.

columns.name: mp_transformrule
columns.notes: Plain-language or controlled transform rule for unit conversion, classification, or aggregation.

columns.name: mp_required
columns.notes: Whether this source is required for the indicator to calculate.

columns.name: mp_active
columns.notes: Inactive mappings are retained for lineage but excluded from new calculations.

columns.name: mp_notes
columns.notes: Review notes, limitations, or source-quality caveats.

tables.name: mp_Observation
tables.purpose: Atomic measured, reported, imported, estimated, or modelled value used as an indicator input.

columns.name: mp_observationkey
columns.notes: Stable key for idempotent observation imports/calculations.

columns.name: mp_project
columns.notes: Project/programme boundary.

columns.name: mp_trackedentity
columns.notes: Beneficiary, group, organisation, facility, or other monitored subject when the observation is entity-level.

columns.name: mp_submission
columns.notes: Canonical submission lineage when observation came from field collection or baseline import.

columns.name: mp_submissionreportrow
columns.notes: Current reporting projection row used to derive the observation.

columns.name: mp_datasourcemapping
columns.notes: Source mapping used to extract or transform the observed value.

columns.name: mp_observedat
columns.notes: When the condition/value was observed.

columns.name: mp_reportingperiod
columns.notes: Period key such as 2026-Q3 or baseline-2026.

columns.name: mp_geography
columns.notes: Region/district/ward label or future geography key.

columns.name: mp_valuedecimal
columns.notes: Numeric value when applicable.

columns.name: mp_valuetext
columns.notes: Text/category value when numeric value is not applicable.

columns.name: mp_unit
columns.notes: Unit snapshot.

columns.name: mp_method
columns.notes: How the observation value was produced.

columns.name: mp_qualitystatus
columns.notes: Data-quality state before indicator calculation.

columns.name: mp_disaggregationjson
columns.notes: Snapshot dimensions such as sex, youth, crop, technology, region, branch, and borrower type.

columns.name: mp_sourcepayloadref
columns.notes: Non-secret pointer to source payload, source row, or field path.

columns.name: mp_notes
columns.notes: Review notes or caveats.

tables.name: mp_Evidence
tables.purpose: Links supporting material, GPS/photo/document references, hashes, timestamps, and verification state to observations or results.

columns.name: mp_evidencekey
columns.notes: Stable evidence key.

columns.name: mp_project
columns.notes: Project/programme boundary.

columns.name: mp_observation
columns.notes: Observation supported by this evidence.

columns.name: mp_indicatorresult
columns.notes: Aggregate result supported by this evidence or evidence summary.

columns.name: mp_submission
columns.notes: Canonical submission lineage where evidence came from field collection.

columns.name: mp_evidencetype
columns.notes: Evidence category.

columns.name: mp_title
columns.notes: Short evidence title for review surfaces.

columns.name: mp_uriorfilereference
columns.notes: Governed file/blob/document reference. Do not store secrets or public bearer URLs.

columns.name: mp_hash
columns.notes: Optional checksum/hash for integrity review.

columns.name: mp_capturedat
columns.notes: Capture timestamp.

columns.name: mp_capturedby
columns.notes: Collector/reviewer identity snapshot where permitted.

columns.name: mp_gpslatitude
columns.notes: Latitude for GPS/photo evidence.

columns.name: mp_gpslongitude
columns.notes: Longitude for GPS/photo evidence.

columns.name: mp_verificationstatus
columns.notes: Evidence verification status.

columns.name: mp_notes
columns.notes: Review notes.

tables.name: mp_IndicatorResult
tables.purpose: Stores calculated or reported indicator facts for dashboards, reports, and future Power BI semantic models.

columns.name: mp_resultkey
columns.notes: Stable key such as projectCode:indicatorCode:period:scope:geography:disaggregationHash.

columns.name: mp_project
columns.notes: Project/programme boundary.

columns.name: mp_indicatordefinition
columns.notes: Indicator definition used to calculate/report this result.

columns.name: mp_reportingperiod
columns.notes: Reporting period key.

columns.name: mp_geography
columns.notes: Region/district/ward/future geography key for aggregate scope.

columns.name: mp_trackedentity
columns.notes: Only set for entity-level indicator facts; leave empty for aggregate results.

columns.name: mp_value
columns.notes: Numeric result value.

columns.name: mp_valuetext
columns.notes: Non-numeric result value or result narrative.

columns.name: mp_unit
columns.notes: Unit snapshot from the definition.

columns.name: mp_method
columns.notes: How the result value was produced.

columns.name: mp_verificationstatus
columns.notes: Do not present official values unless status and method are acceptable for the reporting context.

columns.name: mp_disaggregationjson
columns.notes: Snapshot of applied dimensions and filter values.

columns.name: mp_sourcesummaryjson
columns.notes: Counts and source references used for lineage, excluding sensitive raw identifiers.

columns.name: mp_calculatedat
columns.notes: Calculation or import timestamp.

columns.name: mp_calculatedby
columns.notes: Automation, user, or approved service identity that produced the result.

columns.name: mp_status
columns.notes: Current result rows drive dashboards; superseded rows remain for lineage where retained.

relationships.notes: Allows programme-specific or reusable enterprise indicators.
Each mapping feeds one indicator definition.
Aggregate result evidence or evidence summary.

alternate_keys.name: AK_IndicatorDefinition_Project_Code
alternate_keys.notes: Project-scoped stable indicator code. Review Dataverse key constraints before implementation because lookup columns may require a different physical key strategy.

implementation_gate: Review object names, ownership, and role model with SFU and CRDB administrators.
Confirm Power Automate or service-principal ownership for scheduled calculation before moving official indicator refresh out of the browser.
Confirm field-level Web API exposure only for approved prototype surfaces; do not expose evidence file references broadly.
Confirm whether lookup columns can be used in the approved alternate-key strategy or whether denormalized project/indicator code columns are required.
